historical_tickets.text: I can't log into my account. It keeps saying my password is invalid even though I'm sure it's correct. I've tried resetting it twice but the email never arrives.
historical_tickets.resolution: Password reset email was being blocked by customer's spam filter. Whitelisted our domain and sent new reset link. Customer successfully logged in.

historical_tickets.text: I was charged twice for order #12345. My credit card shows two identical charges of $49.99. This happened yesterday and I need this fixed ASAP.
historical_tickets.resolution: Confirmed duplicate charge in payment system. Initiated refund for duplicate transaction. Refund processed within 24 hours.

historical_tickets.text: The app keeps crashing whenever I try to upload a file larger than 5MB. I'm using Chrome on Windows 11.
historical_tickets.resolution: Identified file upload size limit issue. Engineering team deployed fix to increase limit to 50MB. Confirmed working with customer.

historical_tickets.text: I'd like to know more about your enterprise pricing plans. We're a company of about 200 employees.
historical_tickets.resolution: Connected customer with enterprise sales team. Provided pricing sheet and scheduled demo call.

historical_tickets.text: My account was suspended without any warning or explanation. I need access restored immediately as I have a deadline tomorrow!
historical_tickets.resolution: Account was auto-suspended due to payment failure. Updated payment method and restored access within 1 hour.

historical_tickets.text: The dashboard is loading very slowly, taking 30+ seconds. This started happening this morning.
historical_tickets.resolution: Identified database query performance issue affecting multiple users. Engineering team optimized queries. Dashboard now loads in <3 seconds.

historical_tickets.text: I forgot my username and the email I used to sign up. Can you help me find my account?
historical_tickets.resolution: Located account using customer's phone number. Sent username reminder to verified email address.

historical_tickets.text: I accidentally deleted an important project. Is there any way to recover it?
historical_tickets.resolution: Restored project from backup system. Data recovery completed within 2 hours. Customer confirmed all files intact.

historical_tickets.text: Your invoice shows a different amount than what I was quoted. Invoice #INV-8765 shows $299 but quote was $249.
historical_tickets.resolution: Pricing error identified. Corrected invoice to match quoted price and issued credit for difference.

historical_tickets.text: How do I export my data to CSV format? I can't find the option anywhere in the interface.
historical_tickets.resolution: Provided step-by-step instructions for CSV export feature. Feature is located in Settings > Data > Export.

historical_tickets.text: I need to change my subscription from monthly to annual. Will I get a refund for the remaining days?
historical_tickets.resolution: Switched subscription to annual plan. Prorated credit applied for unused monthly days toward annual payment.

historical_tickets.text: The mobile app won't sync with the web version. Changes I make on mobile don't appear on desktop.
historical_tickets.resolution: Sync issue caused by outdated app version. Instructed customer to update to latest version (v3.2.1). Sync working normally after update.

historical_tickets.text: ERROR: Server returned 500 when I try to save my work. This is happening repeatedly!
historical_tickets.resolution: Server error identified and escalated to engineering. Fix deployed within 30 minutes. Customer able to save work successfully.

historical_tickets.text: Can you help me set up two-factor authentication? I want to make my account more secure.
historical_tickets.resolution: Provided 2FA setup guide. Walked customer through enabling authenticator app. Verified 2FA working correctly.

historical_tickets.text: I was charged for a subscription I cancelled last month. Please refund immediately.
historical_tickets.resolution: Verified cancellation was processed but billing cycle had already started. Issued full refund and confirmed no future charges.

historical_tickets.text: Where can I find the API documentation? I'm trying to integrate your service with our system.
historical_tickets.resolution: Provided link to API documentation at docs.example.com/api. Also shared code examples and invited to developer Slack channel.

historical_tickets.text: I need to add 5 more users to our team account. How do I do that and what's the cost?
historical_tickets.resolution: Explained team pricing ($15/user/month). Added 5 users to account. First invoice will reflect prorated amount.

historical_tickets.text: None of my team members received the invitation emails I sent. Checked spam folders too.
historical_tickets.resolution: Email delivery issue identified. Resent invitations using backup email service. All invitations delivered successfully.

historical_tickets.text: I want to downgrade from Pro to Basic plan. Will I lose any data?
historical_tickets.resolution: Explained data retention policy. All data preserved when downgrading. Processed downgrade, customer billed lower amount next cycle.

historical_tickets.text: Getting 'Permission Denied' error when trying to access shared folders. Worked fine yesterday.
historical_tickets.resolution: Permissions were reset during system maintenance. Restored correct permissions. Customer able to access all shared folders.

historical_tickets.text: Can I get a receipt for my last payment? Need it for expense reporting.
historical_tickets.resolution: Generated and emailed receipt for payment #PAY-45678. Also showed customer how to download receipts from billing section.

historical_tickets.text: The search function isn't working properly. It's not finding files I know exist in my account.
historical_tickets.resolution: Search index was outdated. Triggered manual reindex for customer's account. Search functioning normally within 15 minutes.

historical_tickets.text: I think someone unauthorized accessed my account. Can you check the login history?
historical_tickets.resolution: Reviewed login history, found suspicious login from different location. Reset password, enabled 2FA, revoked all active sessions. Account secured.

historical_tickets.text: Do you offer student discounts? I'm currently enrolled full-time at university.
historical_tickets.resolution: Verified student status. Applied 50% student discount to account. Discount will apply for duration of enrollment.

historical_tickets.text: File upload is stuck at 95% and won't complete. Been like this for 20 minutes.
historical_tickets.resolution: Network timeout issue. Advised customer to try again with smaller chunks. Also increased server timeout limits. Upload completed successfully.

historical_tickets.text: Can I transfer my subscription to a different email address? Changing jobs and won't have access to current email.
historical_tickets.resolution: Verified identity and transferred subscription to new email address. Customer confirmed access with new email working correctly.

historical_tickets.text: The notification emails I'm receiving are overwhelming. How do I adjust notification settings?
historical_tickets.resolution: Guided customer to Settings > Notifications. Helped configure digest mode (1 email/day instead of per event). Customer satisfied with new settings.

historical_tickets.text: I purchased the wrong subscription tier by mistake. Can I exchange it for the correct one?
historical_tickets.resolution: Refunded incorrect subscription purchase. Applied credit to correct tier subscription. No additional charges needed.

historical_tickets.text: Is there a way to bulk import data from Excel? I have about 500 rows to add.
historical_tickets.resolution: Provided bulk import guide and CSV template. Walked through import process. All 500 rows imported successfully without errors.

historical_tickets.text: Application completely frozen! Can't click anything. Just shows spinning loader. Need help NOW!
historical_tickets.resolution: Browser cache corruption causing freeze. Instructed customer to clear cache and hard refresh (Ctrl+Shift+R). Application loaded normally.
